invariants.rationale: The method upsertPrepped returns the result of a non-null execute() call, so result should never be null.
Method signature requires preppedRecords as input, and it is passed directly to the executor.
instantTime is used as an argument for the commit action, so it should be a non-null, non-empty String.
getWriteStatuses() should return a valid List even if empty, per HoodieWriteMetadata contract.
context is cast to HoodieJavaEngineContext and used in the executor, so it must not be null.
